summary: Publishes messages and data payloads to a specific WebSocket channel/topic on the Standalone HttpFileServer broker.

ports.name: Channel
ports.text: Name of the channel/topic to publish this message to (e.g. visualState, cameraPos).

ports.name: Data
ports.text: The payload (object, array, string, number) to broadcast.

ports.name: Publish
ports.text: Trigger to publish the data to all subscribers of the channel.

ports.name: Target Client ID
ports.text: Optional specific client ID to send a direct unicast message to. Leave empty to broadcast to channel subscribers, or '*' to send to all connected clients.

ports.name: Send to All Clients
ports.text: When true, bypasses channel subscription filters and broadcasts this message to every connected WebSocket client.

ports.name: Send to All Channels
ports.text: When true, sets the message channel to '*' and publishes across all channels/topics.

ports.name: Retain
ports.text: If true, the broker caches this message and immediately sends it to any new client that subscribes to this channel in the future.

ports.name: On Published
ports.text: Fires when the message has been dispatched by the broker.

ports.name: Subscribers Count
ports.text: Number of active clients currently subscribed to this channel.

ports.name: Success
ports.text: True if the message was successfully dispatched.
